timetableShape.owner: Course.schedule (JSON array on the courses table)

schemaObservations.detail: The DB was provisioned via `prisma db push` (no migration history recorded). `prisma migrate dev/deploy` against this DB will see a baseline mismatch and must not be run destructively.
schemaObservations.requirement: Phase 1 migration work must establish a non-destructive baseline first (e.g. `prisma migrate diff` to produce an initial migration) and verify record counts before/after.

schemaObservations.detail: Schema maps PendingSync to `pending_sync`, but the live table is quoted `"PendingSync"`, implying it was created from an older schema version.
schemaObservations.requirement: Do not rename/drop the live table. Any schema-rename must be done via an additive migration that preserves rows.
